newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia takes Helsinki one pct up, trade seen thin.
newsitem.headline: Nokia takes Helsinki one pct up, trade seen thin.

text.p: Shares opened higher on Monday on a wave of good sentiment from the U.S. where the Dow leapt to a record high and Nokia racked up big gains on Friday, brokers said.
The HEX index advanced more than one percent in calm early trade, and brokers said the trend looked firm though some said trading volumes seemed set to move to lower summertime levels.
Nokia traded up 9.50 markka at 352.00 after touching 355.00 in sturdy volume on a mainly quiet bourse.
At levels around 352.00-353.00 markka, Nokia was finding both buyers and profit-takers, brokers said.
But bourse newcomer Kyro stole the show, starting at 39.00 markka and hitting 42.00 before returning to its opening levels, still up over 40 percent compared to the 27.00 markka offering.
Trade in the share was heavy, rising to 18 million markka.
"The feeling is rather optimistic," one broker said. "I think (Kyro) will stay at these higher levels," another said.
Kemira was initially stable then eased 0.40 markka to 52.00 in fair 12 million markka volume after reporting January-April profits down but well in line with forecasts.
